tools.name: inspect_repository
tools.description:
Inspect local Python/FastAPI, Docker and Actions evidence under the configured root.

Paths are relative. No target code runs; no network, uploads or remote
repositories. A ready result covers only shipped static rules. Check
complete, issues, coverage and findings before declaring a release ready.
tools.prerequisites: Explicit configured root, relative contained path, compatible baseline if used
tools.outputs: Bounded static findings, complete flag, issues and coverage
tools.approval: Authorized read-only scan; no upload or target-code execution
tools.retry: Safe unchanged read; timestamps can differ; ready is not runtime certification
